# “Finns ingen som kan ta över efter honom”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon kretsade kring den kraftiga börsuppgången som följde efter att Jensen Huang återinsatts som vd för Nvidia, sedan Trump lagt sig i. Programledarna diskuterade bolagsstyrningen och det politiska inflytandet. Episode summary in English: EFN Morgon focused on the huge rally after Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO following Trump's intervention, debating Nvidia's governance and political influence over listed companies. Swedish coverage included capital markets days (Sandvik, Tomra, Vimian), OMXS30 changes (Sobi in, Lifco out), insider selling at Scandi Standard, weak Swedish e-commerce data ahead of Black Week, and BYD's surge in European car sales. Tone was euphoric on markets but skeptical on governance and Swedish consumer/auto sectors.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 TOM — Tomra Systems | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lowered but perhaps more credible margin targets; stock has performed poorly; turnaround candidate.

#### Reasoning

Host frames Tomra as a turnaround candidate after a weak share price. The new 16-18% EBITDA margin target is below the old 18% and has no end date, but the host suggests a lower target the company actually believes in could be positive. It's called an interesting stock, but no explicit buy view is given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if company fails to deliver on even the lowered 16-18% margin range
- if turnaround stalls

> *"Aktien har gått jättedåligt. Turner around-kandidat. Det kanske är bra med lägre mål som man tror på. Intressant aktie."*

---

### ⛔ LIFCO-B — Lifco | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Exits OMXS30 on 1 Dec; down ~19% YTD; host says it's on a downslope.

#### Reasoning

Removal from OMXS30 usually causes index-driven selling pressure. Lifco has already fallen about 19-20% this year, and the host calls it a downslope with the index exit as another sign of that. Negative short-term momentum view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if earnings momentum re-accelerates
- after index rebalancing flows are absorbed

> *"Det känns som att Lifco är i en utförslöpa. Det här var ännu ett tecken."*

---

### 🟠 SCST — Scandi Standard | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Structural major owner Grupo Lucianes now selling shares after long lifting the price.

#### Reasoning

A structural buyer that supported the share price has started selling, possibly to fund its Padeza acquisition. Hosts call the reversal interesting and joke about 'peak chicken protein'. Cautious tone, but no explicit sell call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Grupo Lucianes continues heavy selling
- if other major owners also exit

> *"Det är intressant att en strukturell köpare som länge fått kursen att lyfta nu har bytt riktning."*
